tasks.description: Validate leased initial observation answers and provide them to the photo diagnosis prompt.
constraints: Return an exact unified Git diff in JSON. Local tests only. Use accepted lease initial_context. Read only the three enumerated context values. Validate before image access/provider consumption, fail closed when malformed or attached to identification/repeat. Share the already accepted Edge validator in a small dependency-free module if useful.

Pass initial_context into both provider routes through the existing classification adapter. Keep repeat_context separate; never create synthetic history or forward IDs, photos other than the selected one, personal descriptions, or unsupported keys. Unknown is unknown. Initial facts are background only; existing photo evidence and published catalogue constraints still apply. Legacy lease without context, repeat and identification must behave as before.

Add local assertions that validated initial answers reach the exact provider payload, untrusted keys do not reach provider, unrelated jobs are preserved and prior fixture paths still pass. Keep T039/T170 open for signed live acceptance. No service deployment, no quota or authorization changes.

Before deployment verify new context replays follow the same revoked-photo guard as create_bound_photo_analysis_job. If the guard is missing in the still-undeployed 202611160002 wrapper, add it after the exact receipt check and extend clean/upgrade pgTAP using a deleted source plant. Preserve the receipt identity and all existing ACLs.

acceptance_criteria.description: Deno fixtures prove bounded provider forwarding and rejects untrusted context.
